summary: Short kerb at a street corner with homes 11 to 15 m away.
reasons: House 11 m away on the same side
Only 13 m, barely a van length

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes at 11, 12 and 15 m, with gardens and houses all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed street bending at a corner; the 13 m of kerb is hemmed by hedges and a driveway, so a van would sit in the lane.
drivers.convention: One car parked further down the street; no parking convention at this corner.

sun_shade: Part shaded by garden trees on both sides; open overhead.
